title: Consent record for a voluntarily recorded speaker (docs/CONSENTED_RECORDING_PLAN.md)
description: Stored separately from audio. Contains NO name, phone, e-mail, address, national id, exact birth date, precise location, IP address or device identifier. The link to a reachable person (for withdrawal) is a random withdrawal token held by the speaker; the project keeps only its sha256. Commercial training eligibility requires ALL of ml_training, voice_anonymization_rnd, commercial_product_development, model_evaluation and derivative_model_training; otherwise the speaker is NOT_COMMERCIAL_TRAINING_ELIGIBLE.

consent_id.description: random, issued at consent time; printed for the speaker

speaker_pseudonym.description: random; the manifest speaker id; never derived from identity

form_sha256.description: hash of the exact consent text shown

adult_confirmed.description: speaker confirmed age >= 18; minors are not recorded

ml_training.description: recordings may be used to train machine-learning models

voice_anonymization_rnd.description: use for voice-anonymization research and development

commercial_product_development.description: use to develop a commercial product (models that ship)

derivative_model_training.description: models derived from models trained on the recordings may be trained and shipped

audio_redistribution.description: share raw audio outside the project (default false)

collector.description: collection campaign id, not a person

consent_timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 time the consent was given
